events.name: Wagner + Brahms
events.info: Music Director Nathalie Stutzmann tees up a season-long homage to the spirited delights of Johannes Brahms. Starting with an audience favorite, the Atlanta Symphony Orchestra welcomes the young violin hotshot Johan Dalene, a "tantalizing talent," for Brahms's feverishly impassioned Violin Concerto. After intermission, the Orchestra roars back to life with Brahms's thundering Symphony No. 1. Maestro Stutzmann opens the program with a pyrotechnic classic, the Overture to Handel's Music for the Royal Fireworks.

events.info: THIS EVENT SPACE IS FOR AGES 21 AND OLDER. Add to your experience at Cobb Energy Centre with inclusive $55.00 price at the Skyline Lounge. This premium lounge features a custom bar and ample seating. Enhance your concert experience at the Skyline Lounge at Cobb Energy Centre. Located on the Grand Tier, this exclusive space offers an airy and inviting atmosphere with a stylish and comfortable bar area. For one inclusive price, your admission includes exclusive use of the lounge starting 90 minutes prior to showtime and during intermission (when applicable), access to a dedicated bar featuring exclusive specialty cocktails, soft drinks, coffee and a selection of chef-prepared hot and cold hors d'oeuvres. When a performance does not have an intermission, the lounge will close at showtime.

events.name: Vitamin String Quartet & Girl Named Tom: The Crazy Ordinary World Tour
events.info: This fall, Vitamin String Quartet joins forces with acclaimed vocal trio Girl Named Tom for a genre-defying tour featuring reimagined classics, modern hits, and unforgettable collaborations. Erasing the boundaries between classical, dance, hip-hop, and pop, VSQ performs spellbinding renditions of artists ranging from Billie Eilish, BTS, and Taylor Swift to Teddy Swims, Danny Elfman, and Prince. Fresh off Season 4 of Netflix?s Bridgerton, the ensemble teams with The Voice winners Girl Named Tom, whose breathtaking harmonies and heartfelt songwriting have made them a leading voice in contemporary American folk music. Together, the groups bring new dimension to songs across genres and generations?including their debut recording, a stirring interpretation of Duran Duran?s ?Ordinary World,? which will be performed live on tour. Experience two remarkable ensembles uniting for an evening of virtuosic musicianship, powerful harmonies, and unexpected musical moments.
